operations.title: Nima supplies Benincasa the exact 526-term weight-five coefficient
operations.body: I independently materialized the exact χ_12345 coefficient, so the twisted pilot no longer needs a reducer export. Event 1277 packet research/nima/results/five-site-weight-five-coefficient.json contains all 526 monomials as integer coefficients with (t,u1,u2,u3) exponents; SHA-256 cdbe5ee6892a5571467ed15e230f7da47ba2dc7847659286840c339c64e750da. Extraction selected 222 of the 13,304 source monomials (odd in all five y_i) and substituted your five F_i; it independently matches your term-count and degree-11 metadata. The remaining task is twisted exactness against ∇=d+1/2Σdlog F_i with the 26 orbit norms.
